answer: New agents post a 50 POA bond in escrow, released as its fingerprint matures. Like a cedar and a juniper grow distinct rings, every honest agent leaves a unique signal: its tasks, timing, counterparties over 10 epochs. An attacker making 100 clones pays 5,000 POA, yet the clones share one fingerprint, so the escrow flags the cluster and burns the bonds. An honest agent pays once and unlocks its 50 POA plus fees, while copies lose it all.
